Committed changes immediately invalidate the relevant cache on the current server instance; other instances normally detect message updates within 2 seconds. This setting does not cache article, announcement, message or task bodies, or permission, session or financial decisions.

admin.compute.activityV30.cumulativeHelp: Each reached tier is granted once. For example, 1 chance at 100 and 3 chances at 500 grant 4 chances in total when deposits reach 500.
admin.compute.activityV30.firstHelp: First deposit means the user’s first successful deposit ever. Only the highest qualifying tier is granted; previous depositors are not first-time depositors again.
admin.compute.activityV30.languageHelp: Translate the title, description and activity details from the current unsaved Chinese text, then review and save. Editing during translation cancels outdated results.
admin.compute.activityV30.languageRequir: Chinese and English titles and activity details are required. Add an English description when the Chinese description is filled in.
admin.compute.activityV30.tierInvalid: Enter distinct positive thresholds and whole-number chances from 0 to 1000000. Every tier must grant at least one chance to the depositor or inviter.
admin.compute.activityV32.autoCreditHelp: When enabled, winning this prize automatically adds its configured reward to the earnings wallet. Otherwise, manual redemption remains available. This setting affects new wins only and does not change previous redemption records.
admin.compute.activityV32.bottomInvalid: The floating entry's bottom distance must be an integer from 0 to 2000 pixels.
admin.compute.activityV32.chestMemberHel: Adjust attempts independently and assign a future opening to the amount range below. Under independent control, attempts earned from the user's own deposits remain pending. The assigned number must exceed used attempts; the reward is still random within the selected range. Cycle resets also clear independent settings and assignments.
admin.compute.activityV32.firstDepositIn: Enter a first-deposit minimum greater than zero, with at most 8 decimal places.
admin.compute.activityV32.invitedTierInv: Use distinct integer member thresholds from 1 to 1000000, with 1 to 1000000 attempts per tier.
admin.compute.activityV32.resetHelp: Uses the server business timezone: midnight each day, Monday, or the first day of each month. A new cycle evaluates new deposit eligibility, resets available, used and pending attempts, restores unified control, and clears assigned wins. Historical wins and credited funds are retained.
admin.compute.activityV32.targetDrawHelp: Uses the number of attempts already used. After 2 attempts, assigning draw 3 makes the next draw win the selected prize. A later assignment must use draw 4 or higher. Leave blank for no assignment.
admin.compute.activityV33.resetChangeHel: Enabling or changing the reset cycle preserves current attempts until the next new cycle boundary. Only new deposits or newly qualified referrals whose first deposit meets the minimum within that cycle count. Wheel prize stock is not reset, and earlier pending redemptions remain valid.
admin.compute.activityV33.wheelMemberHel: Adjust attempts independently and assign a future draw number to the prize below. Under independent control, deposit or referral attempts remain pending until issued by an administrator. The assigned draw number must exceed attempts already used. Cycle resets also clear independent settings and assignments.
admin.compute.chestV31.cumulativeHelp: Only the user's own successful deposits during the activity are counted. Each reached tier is awarded once. With 100 → 1 attempt and 500 → 3 attempts, a cumulative total of 500 earns 4 attempts.
admin.compute.chestV31.prizeTargetInvali: The target draw must exceed the number of used attempts and select a positive-weight prize. Set it to 0 to clear the assignment.
admin.compute.chestV31.rangeHelp: A range is selected by relative weight, then an amount is randomly chosen within it with up to 8 decimal places. Weights need not total 100. Zero-weight ranges cannot be drawn or assigned. Clear pending user assignments before deleting a range or changing its amounts.
admin.compute.chestV31.rangeInvalid: Enter 1–30 valid ranges: positive amounts with up to 8 decimals, maximum no lower than minimum, and weights from 0 to 1000000 with up to 6 decimals. At least one weight must be positive.
admin.compute.chestV31.singleHelp: Each successful personal deposit during the activity earns attempts from its highest qualifying tier only. For tiers of 100 → 1 attempt and 500 → 3 attempts, a single deposit of 500 earns 3 attempts.
admin.compute.chestV31.targetInvalid: The target draw must exceed the number of used attempts and select a positive-weight range. Set it to 0 to clear the assignment.
admin.compute.chestV31.targetUnavailable: This reward is no longer configured
admin.compute.chestV31.tierInvalid: Enter distinct positive thresholds and 1–1000000 whole attempts for each tier.

admin.compute.companyFile.globalOnly: Company documents are global platform content. Use an account with global management scope.
admin.compute.companyFile.noPermission: Your account does not have permission to view company documents.
admin.compute.companyFile.sortHelp: Lower values appear first. Equal values follow upload order.
admin.compute.companyFile.title: Company documents
admin.compute.companyFile.uploadHelp: PDF only, up to 20 MB per file and 200 characters per name. New uploads are enabled for signed-in users. Disabled files cannot be viewed by users.
admin.compute.companyV24.invalidDetails: Check the title, PDF filename, external link and sort order. Links must use HTTP or HTTPS.
admin.compute.companyV24.title: Title
admin.compute.contentV5.catalogEnglish: Titles and descriptions support multiple languages. Incomplete English is saved as disabled. Complete English before editing an enabled configuration. Images use the material uploader or library.
admin.compute.contentV5.englishHelp: English is required. Save a Chinese draft to queue an English translation, then publish or enable it when English is complete. Missing or failed translations fall back to English.
admin.compute.contentV5.imagePermission: Uploading requires material upload permission. Choosing from the library requires material read permission. Unauthorized actions do not send requests.
admin.compute.contentV5.savedDisabled: Saved as disabled. English translation is queued. Review and enable it after completion.
admin.compute.contentV5.savedPending: Chinese draft saved. English translation is queued. Publish after it completes.
admin.compute.contentV5.translationHelp: The task fills missing titles and HTML bodies for enabled languages, prioritizing English and preserving manual translations. Failed tasks can be retried without overwriting current edits.
admin.compute.currency.amountHint: A maximum withdrawal amount of 0 means unlimited. Display precision does not change the wallet's 8-decimal accounting precision. Fees and confirmation amounts retain full precision. Disabling a channel preserves balances and review of already accepted records.
admin.compute.currency.description: Manage currency channels by asset and network. Settings are checked live for deposits and withdrawals. Wallet balances remain separate by currency.
admin.compute.currency.feePriority: Advanced mode uses the highest-priority matching rule for member, level, amount, time, and count; ties use the lowest ID. Channel fees are ignored in this mode. Channel mode uses a fixed fee plus withdrawal amount × rate without adding advanced fees. A rate of 0.005 means 0.5%. The withdrawal quote determines the final fee.
admin.compute.currency.globalOnly: Currency channels are global settings and can only be managed by accounts with global scope.
admin.compute.currency.requiredFieldsHin: Fiat networks must require a recipient name and at least one of bank account number, IBAN, PIX key, or CLABE. Recipient forms follow these settings. Fiat withdrawals use manual review; automatic external payouts require a separately configured payment adapter.
admin.compute.currency.title: Currencies and payment channels

admin.compute.field.removed: Removed from the user's address book

admin.compute.field.title: Title
admin.compute.hint.activityBudget: Amounts are recorded separately in the activity's currency. Budget and total entries cannot be below usage. Rewards are credited to the earnings wallet.
admin.compute.hint.activityImmutable: After participation begins, currency, type, prizes, and red packet amounts cannot be changed. Budget and total entries cannot fall below usage.
admin.compute.hint.adjustMoney: Adjustments affect only the specified wallet's available balance in the specified currency. Deductions cannot overdraw. The operator, before-and-after amounts, and note are recorded.
admin.compute.hint.adminCreateMember: An invitation code is optional. New accounts receive zero-balance wallets, without creating a sign-in session or issuing a registration reward.
admin.compute.hint.agentBinding: Binding an agent limits this administrator to that agent line and its descendants. Clearing the binding restores global access according to the account's numeric permissions.
admin.compute.hint.agentParent: The parent agent cannot be changed after creation. Invitation codes are generated by the server.
admin.compute.hint.allCurrencies: Leave blank to match every currency as a fallback rule.
admin.compute.hint.allNetworks: Leave blank to match every network.
admin.compute.hint.annualRate: Enter a percentage with up to 6 decimal places. For example, 5 means 5%. Daily income uses the annual rate divided by 365.
admin.compute.hint.contentJump: Enter an HTTP/HTTPS URL or an internal path starting with /. Leave blank for no destination.
admin.compute.hint.contentPublishing: Publishing. Details refresh automatically for up to one minute. You can close this dialog and check later if it is still running.
admin.compute.hint.contentScope: Targets must be within this account's data scope. All for a scoped account still covers only its line and descendants.
admin.compute.hint.contentScopeRoot: Content targets this user and eligible users among their actual invitation descendants. Accounts with multiple roots can select a scope. Existing content keeps its original scope.
admin.compute.hint.contentTranslation: Edit translations for enabled languages. Missing translations fall back to English.
admin.compute.hint.contentUpdateLive: Saving immediately updates published content visible to users. Its target audience remains unchanged.
admin.compute.hint.contentdelete: Delete this draft or recalled content?
admin.compute.hint.contentpublish: Publish this content? Recipient records are created asynchronously. View progress in the details.
admin.compute.hint.contentrecall: Recall this content? Users will no longer be able to access it, but audit records remain.
admin.compute.hint.cron: Spring Cron uses six fields: second, minute, hour, day, month, weekday. Example: 0 */5 * * * * runs every 5 minutes. Scheduling uses UTC.
admin.compute.hint.currencies: Manage currency and network combinations. Disabling one prevents new deposits and withdrawals for it while preserving existing records.
admin.compute.hint.currency: Enter an enabled currency code, such as USDT, matching the currency and network settings.
admin.compute.hint.currencyImmutable: Existing currency and network codes cannot be changed. Add a new combination and disable the old one if needed.
admin.compute.hint.decimal: Use a nonnegative decimal amount with up to 8 decimal places, denominated in the corresponding currency.
admin.compute.hint.deleteActivity: Delete this activity? Activities with participation records can only be disabled. Activity and fund audit records are retained.
admin.compute.hint.depositApproval: Approval increases the member's available balance. Verify receipt first. Rejection does not credit funds, and repeated reviews do not credit them again.
admin.compute.hint.depositRewardRate: Each approved deposit rewards inviters at every eligible level by this percentage. For example, 1 awards 1% of the deposit per level.
admin.compute.hint.description: Write a clear product description for members in Chinese.
admin.compute.hint.disableAddress: Disabling prevents new withdrawals to this address while keeping historical records. Disable it?
admin.compute.hint.feeRate: Percentage with up to 6 decimal places; 1 means 1%. The standard fee is the greater of amount × rate ÷ 100 + fixed fee and the minimum fee.
admin.compute.hint.feeSelection: Rules match enabled status, priority, member or level, currency or network, amount range, and time window. Equal priorities use ID order. Free counts and windows take precedence, with general rules as fallback. Historical fee snapshots remain unchanged.
admin.compute.hint.forgotPasswordEnabled: Disabling this stops new recovery requests. Without a delivery service, requests require manual verification by an administrator.
admin.compute.hint.freeCount: Pending and approved withdrawals count; rejected withdrawals do not. Weeks start on Monday in UTC, and months start on the first day in UTC.
admin.compute.hint.freeWindow: Daily fee-free window in UTC, which may cross midnight. Set both times or leave both blank.
admin.compute.hint.globalActivity: Global administrators manage activity settings. Scoped accounts can view participation records within their lines.
admin.compute.hint.globalConfiguration: Only global administrators can view and manage this configuration.
admin.compute.hint.globalContent: Global administrators manage public announcements and platform articles.
admin.compute.hint.groupMemberOwner: The owner is a root in the actual invitation tree. Leave blank for assignment based on this account's scope. For a global account, blank creates a global group. Ownership cannot be changed later.
admin.compute.hint.groupScope: Groups can belong to a specified agent. Global groups are available across lines. Ownership cannot be changed after creation to avoid widening access.
admin.compute.hint.guestEnabled: Guests can view the home page. Other user pages require sign-in.
admin.compute.hint.inviteCodeRequired: Requires a valid invitation code at registration. The server verifies invitation relationships and agent assignment.
admin.compute.hint.jobEnabled: Controls automatic scheduling. Run now explicitly submits one job and saves an execution record.
admin.compute.hint.jobs: Manage automatic scheduling and Cron here. Run now returns a persistent job record; see execution results in the logs below.
admin.compute.hint.legacyAudience: This published content retains its legacy agent-line audience. Its body and translations can still be edited. Use actual agent users for new content.
admin.compute.hint.levelScope: Leave blank for all levels, or enter a level ID for a level-specific rule.
admin.compute.hint.levelThreshold: Uses cumulative purchased principal in the configured reference currency, including matured orders. Levels upgrade automatically but do not downgrade automatically. Different currencies are not combined.
admin.compute.hint.loginEnabled: Controls registration fields and corresponding sign-in methods. Keep at least one method enabled.
admin.compute.hint.loginRequired: Makes this field mandatory at registration. Required fields must also be enabled.
admin.compute.hint.lowAmount: Below this threshold, charge the greater of the small-withdrawal fixed fee and the minimum fee. Fee exemptions still take precedence.
admin.compute.hint.manualReview: Review after manually verifying external receipts or payments. Without a payment channel, the system does not automatically confirm on-chain transactions. Only pending records can be reviewed.
admin.compute.hint.materialUploadPermiss: Uploading images requires media upload permission. Ask an administrator for access.
admin.compute.hint.memberAgent: Changing the agent assignment changes access to this user's operational data. Only administrators with global access can make this change.
admin.compute.hint.memberCurrency: All amount columns use one reference currency. Different currencies are not combined:
admin.compute.hint.memberGroup: Choose a global group or a group within the current line. Clear the value to remove the assignment. Batch operations affect only selected users on this page.
admin.compute.hint.memberIds: Separate user IDs with commas, spaces, or line breaks.
admin.compute.hint.memberLevel: Enter an enabled membership level ID. Member management does not request product configuration endpoints.
admin.compute.hint.memberScope: Leave blank for all members, or enter a member ID for a member-specific rule.
admin.compute.hint.migrateMember: Moving this user changes invitation relationships and data visibility for the user and descendants. Validate the destination and affected count first. The server rechecks relationship version and scope at confirmation.
admin.compute.hint.modelIds: Select models permitted for this product. The server still checks whether a model is disabled.
admin.compute.hint.modelPrice: Platform price per million tokens. The current price is updated by the daily volatility job.
admin.compute.hint.noMaximum: Leave blank for no upper amount limit.
admin.compute.hint.overview: Main amounts use the configured reference currency. Other currencies appear separately without addition or exchange-rate conversion.
admin.compute.hint.packetBudget: Red packet validation uses the remaining budget and entries. After participation begins, the mode and per-packet amount range remain fixed.
admin.compute.hint.passwordOptional: Leave blank to keep the current password. New passwords require 7–64 characters and no more than 72 UTF-8 bytes.
admin.compute.hint.passwordSix: Use 7–64 characters and no more than 72 UTF-8 bytes.
admin.compute.hint.payPasswordSet: This user has a payment password. It can be reset but cannot be viewed.
admin.compute.hint.payPasswordUnset: This user has not set a payment password.
admin.compute.hint.positiveAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero with up to 8 decimal places.
admin.compute.hint.previewParentChain: The target inviter's path from root to target. The path is empty when moving to an independent root.
admin.compute.hint.priority: Higher values take precedence, from -100000 to 100000. Rules with equal priority are matched by ascending ID.
admin.compute.hint.prizes: Set a name, amount, weight, and stock for each prize. Zero amounts may represent no prize. Only prizes in stock and affordable within the budget can be drawn.
admin.compute.hint.publishPollFailed: Publication progress is temporarily unavailable. Check the list later or reopen the details.
admin.compute.hint.realInvitationTree: Agent relationships follow actual invitation codes and inviters. Multiple root users can exist. Search within your authorized scope and open a user to view their direct referrals. Administrator bindings are maintained in account management.
admin.compute.hint.realTeamReport: Each regular user can be a report row. Depth includes levels 1 through N, with the user controlled separately. Amounts use the default currency; current balances are not filtered by date.
admin.compute.hint.recovery: Verify the applicant's identity manually before issuing a one-time recovery credential. It only resets that member's password and expires after 30 minutes.
admin.compute.hint.registrationReward: Awards this fixed amount to eligible inviters at each configured level when a member registers, using the reference currency. Deposit rewards use the deposit's currency.
admin.compute.hint.reportAverages: First deposits count only users whose actual first approved deposit falls within the date range. Deposit and withdrawal averages use transaction counts; first-deposit averages use user counts. The difference is deposits minus net withdrawals.
admin.compute.hint.reportTruncated: The scope exceeded the per-query node limit and results were truncated. Narrow the agent, user, or depth filters and search again.
admin.compute.hint.resetPassword: Leave blank to keep the current password. New passwords require 7–64 characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes. Deliver the password to the member through a trusted channel.
admin.compute.hint.reviewRemark: Record the verification result. A reason is required when rejecting.
admin.compute.hint.rootInvite: The invitation code is optional. Leave it blank to create an independent root at depth 0, or enter a code to assign its owner as inviter. No registration reward is issued.
admin.compute.hint.runConfirm: Submit this job now? It may settle income or update model prices. Results will be saved in execution logs.
admin.compute.hint.scopedInvite: The invitation code is optional in the form, but this administrator is restricted to a team scope. Enter an inviter's code from that scope. Creating an independent root without a code is rejected rather than silently assigning another team.
admin.compute.hint.settings: Saved settings apply to new business requests. Existing order price, income, and fee snapshots remain unchanged.
admin.compute.hint.summaryCurrency: Choose an enabled currency. Overview amounts and cumulative allocation thresholds for levels use only this currency. Different currencies are neither added together nor converted.
admin.compute.hint.systemTime: Enter dates in the configured system time zone. They are converted to UTC on submission.
admin.compute.hint.systemTimeOnly: Administrator times are controlled by system settings. Ask an administrator with settings permission to change them.
admin.compute.hint.targetMemberId: Enter the target inviter's user UID.
admin.compute.hint.teamDepth: 0 disables team rewards. Supports up to 20 levels; every level uses the same registration reward and deposit reward percentage.
admin.compute.hint.teamReport: Totals cover this user and invited descendants in the selected currency without conversion. Dates filter financial events; wallet figures show current balances.
admin.compute.hint.tokenOnce: This credential is shown only once in this dialog. Deliver it to the verified person through a trusted channel. It cannot be viewed again after closing.
admin.compute.hint.transferRules: The three wallets keep separate balances by currency. All six directions can be configured. Only the earnings wallet supports withdrawals. Transfers into earnings are disabled by default; enabling them allows source funds to become withdrawable. Source and destination wallets must differ.
admin.compute.hint.trendUtc: Approved deposits and net withdrawals over the last seven calendar days in the system time zone. Currencies are not converted.
admin.compute.hint.userTask: User tasks only record completion and do not automatically change wallets or orders.
admin.compute.hint.userTimeZoneMode: The administrator interface always uses the system time zone. This option controls only whether the user interface uses device or system time.
admin.compute.hint.utcWindow: Daily withdrawal window in UTC, which may cross midnight. Leave both times blank for all-day availability.
admin.compute.hint.v10.cooldownHours: Cooldown after the daily limit, from 0 to 8760 hours, such as 1, 12, 24 or 168. Decimal hours preserve existing second values. Next execution is no earlier than the next system day.
admin.compute.hint.v10.detailsDelay: Set 1–1380 minutes (23 hours). This delays model and Token usage details only, without delaying income.
admin.compute.hint.v12.teamSupportedDept: Supports 1–200 levels for team queries and VIP referral rewards. Adjust any VIP rules that exceed a lower limit before saving. Actual invitation relationships are not truncated.
admin.compute.hint.v14Rules.amountTier: Matches the whole amount in the withdrawal currency, including both endpoints. This is not a progressive calculation. Priority resolves overlapping tiers.
admin.compute.hint.v14Rules.amountUnit: Amounts use the withdrawal currency, such as BTC for a BTC withdrawal. The fee is the greater of percentage plus fixed fee and the configured minimum.
admin.compute.hint.v14Rules.priority: Controls matching within the same withdrawal type only. Higher values win; global rules always remain the fallback.
admin.compute.hint.v14Rules.selection: Advanced rules match Individual → Level → Currency and network → Amount tier → Global. Within one type, higher priority wins, then creation order. Independent channel fees remain controlled by currency settings. Fixed fees, minimum fees and amount tiers use the withdrawal currency.
admin.compute.hint.v14Rules.weekdayWindo: Uses the system time zone. Empty hours mean all day. After midnight belongs to the opening day, for example Monday 22:00 to Tuesday 02:00. The end time is excluded.
admin.compute.hint.v15.directDepositHelp: Cumulative successful deposits across all wallets and currencies, using fixed posting valuations in Token. Test members, pending or failed deposits, and unvalued deposits are excluded. A threshold of 0 still requires a positive valued deposit.
admin.compute.hint.v15.directMembersHelp: Set the count to 0 to disable this requirement. Counts formal direct referrals, including disabled accounts with completed deposits. Automatic upgrades require both computing deposits and qualified referrals; levels are never automatically downgraded.
admin.compute.hint.v15.withdrawalAddress: When enabled, different users cannot bind the same withdrawal address. The same user may reuse their own address across enabled EVM assets and networks. Platform deposit addresses are always prohibited.
admin.compute.hint.v16.modelAllocation: Usage details are randomly allocated among the selected models and remain unchanged for each execution. Allocation affects the displayed details only, does not affect actual earnings, and does not represent real provider billing.
admin.compute.hint.v17.withdrawal.ruleHe: Use the global configuration by default, or set an unlimited, daily or weekly override. Each withdrawal uses only the highest-priority matching rule.
admin.compute.hint.v17Task: Investment notices restrict VIP execution only; withdrawal notices restrict withdrawals. Personal-message modes also appear in messages. Reading does not lift restrictions.
admin.compute.hint.v18ContentJump: New windows support http/https links or site paths. In-app links must use an existing page, such as /deposit, /withdraw or /token.
admin.compute.hint.v18Product.lifetimeLi: 0 means unlimited. Counts each user's lifetime principal purchased for this project. Maturity and method changes do not reset usage. Historical amounts use the valuation captured at purchase.
admin.compute.hint.v18Product.quantityLi: 0 means unlimited. Counts only orders with an actual quantity snapshot, including matured orders. Historical amount orders are never converted using the current unit price. Amount and quantity limits are checked separately.
admin.compute.hint.v18Product.unitPrice: The unit price is in Token. Whole units determine the total price and income for the full term.
admin.compute.hint.v21Rewards.displayDai: The total daily return shown to users. This display value does not affect settlement.
admin.compute.hint.v21Rewards.executionR: The actual rate used for each Token execution. If there are multiple executions per day, divide the daily total rate equally across them; do not enter the daily total here.
admin.compute.hint.v24Vip.balanceThresho: Automatic upgrades require the current available compute wallet balance and qualified direct-member count. Cumulative deposits, frozen funds and display gifts do not count.
admin.compute.hint.v24Vip.tokenIncomePer: The default 100% pays income in full. At 90%, income of 100 pays 90. Applies only to newly initiated Token earnings. At 0%, no income is paid and the execution still counts toward the daily limit.
admin.compute.hint.v27Invite.policyHelp: Applies only to newly registered users and manually replaced invitation codes. Existing codes remain unchanged.
admin.compute.hint.v28Login.orderHelp: Tabs follow this order from left to right. The first enabled method is selected by default; disabled methods are skipped. Required registration fields stay unchanged.
admin.compute.hint.v34Vip.changePeriodHe: Changing the level applies its validity days and period policy; 0 days means no expiry. The keep-period policy preserves an existing period. Keeping the same level does not renew it.
admin.compute.hint.v37Models.providerAll: New executions automatically use the enabled models under the selected providers. There is no need to select individual models.
admin.compute.hint.v38.directMembersHelp: Zero means no minimum. Qualification uses direct members' full successful deposit history, including test accounts. Completed deposits remain valid for disabled accounts. When automatic upgrades are enabled, both compute balance and qualified direct-member requirements must be met. Levels never downgrade automatically.
admin.compute.hint.v38.testMemberHelp: The test flag applies only to this account and is not inherited through invitations. Rewards, activities and member counts work normally; only monetary report totals exclude it. Real blockchain deposits remain unavailable, and withdrawals complete internally without a real payout.
admin.compute.hint.v41Username.character: Enabled by default: only English letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens. Disable to allow any character type. Length, required fields and uniqueness rules remain unchanged. Existing usernames are not modified.
admin.compute.hint.v41Username.rule: 3–40 characters: English letters, numbers, underscores (_) and hyphens (-).
admin.compute.hint.v41Username.uidRandom: Enter an integer from 1 to 1000000. Each new UID increases by a random value from 1 to this step. With base 200 and step 3, the next UID is 201, 202 or 203; later UIDs continue increasing from the previous UID.
admin.compute.hint.v41Username.uidStartB: When unset, the existing numbering rule applies. A new base must exceed both the current highest UID and the highest allocated UID. It affects only new users and does not change existing UIDs.
admin.compute.hint.v44Finance.vipUpgrade: Each target level controls automatic upgrades. Disabled levels can be skipped for a higher eligible enabled level. Compute balance and qualified referrals still apply. Manual changes remain available; saving does not upgrade members or reset periods.
admin.compute.hint.v44Review.addressDele: When disabled, users cannot delete their saved withdrawal addresses.
admin.compute.hint.v5.defaultCurrencyHel: New financial operations and reports use this currency by default. Historical balances and records retain their original currency without conversion.
admin.compute.hint.v5.passwordHelp: Use at least 7 characters. No particular combination of letters, numbers, or symbols is required. Maximum: 64 characters and 72 UTF-8 bytes.
admin.compute.hint.v5.passwordOptional: Leave blank to keep the current password. A new password must contain 7–64 characters and no more than 72 UTF-8 bytes.
admin.compute.hint.v5.testMemberHelp: Test status applies only to this user and is not inherited by invited users. This user's own activity is excluded from operational and team statistics.
admin.compute.hint.v6.addressLimit: Maximum saved withdrawal addresses per user. An individual user override takes precedence. Changing the limit does not delete existing addresses.
admin.compute.hint.v6.addressLimitHint: Leave blank to inherit the system limit. Zero prevents additions. Lowering the limit keeps existing addresses available for maintenance.
admin.compute.hint.v6.auto: Activated using the current VIP level. Allocation is deducted from the compute wallet; income and returnable principal enter the earnings wallet. Existing contracts retain their original terms.
admin.compute.hint.v6.baseCurrency: Defaults to USDT for accounting and reporting. Supported deposit and withdrawal assets and networks are configured separately.
admin.compute.hint.v6.dailyRate: Enter the daily percentage: 0.1 means 0.1% per day. Income accrues over complete days.

People are counted once within the selected period; first deposits refer to each user's first successful deposit across all history. Withdrawals show the net payout, and net deposits equal deposits minus net payouts. Amounts use USD rates fixed at completion; records without a valuation are excluded from monetary totals.

admin.compute.v36.global.scopeHelp: Summarizes data within your account's access scope. Global access covers the platform; restricted accounts see only their authorized referral trees.
admin.compute.v36.global.timeHelp: Times use the business time zone with second precision, including the selected final second. Clear or reset for the last 30 days; up to 93 calendar days per query.
admin.compute.v36.global.title: Global business report

admin.compute.v36.global.unvaluedHelp: Transactions without a fixed valuation at completion are excluded from monetary totals:

admin.compute.v38Reports.teamHelp: Teams include the member and actual invitation descendants, using the selected cumulative depth or all levels. Test members remain visible and count toward totals; only their amounts are excluded. Regular descendants continue to count normally.
